title: Terraform module: GPU nodepool with rolling upgrades and ASG/Karpenter integration
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a reusable Terraform module that provisions GPU-backed node pools for Private (VPC) deployments with first-class support for both AWS ASG-based nodegroups and Karpenter provisioners. The module must support safe rolling upgrades for GPU drivers/AMI changes, expose health-check wiring for autoscaling decisions, and provide clear inputs/outputs for integration into the Private deployment Helm charts and the control plane. This ticket covers module design, implementation, docs, and an automated test plan for canary rollout verification.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module creates GPU node groups using either ASG or Karpenter based on input flag
Module includes lifecycle hooks and SSM-compatible scripts to drain and cordon nodes for rolling upgrades
GPU driver update path is automated via a DaemonSet + pre-drain validation script; nodes are only removed from service after kernel/driver checks pass
Health check endpoints (node readiness probe + exporter metrics) are registered so autoscalers (ASG/Karpenter) can respect GPU memory/thermal signals
Module outputs (node_role_arn, security_group_ids, subnet_ids, provisioner_name) are documented and usable by Private control plane templates
Automated terraform plan/apply smoke tests run in private-e2e environment and validate canary upgrade workflow
Security review completed and KMS/HSM integration patterns documented if module manages any sensitive bootstrap data
terraform_changes_summary: Inputs: use_karpenter (bool), instance_types (list), gpu_type (string), taints (list), tolerations (list), drain_timeout (string), max_unavailable (int)
Outputs: node_role_arn, node_group_name, provisioner_name, security_group_ids, instance_profile_id
Implements optional ASG with lifecycle hooks and Karpenter provisioner manifest generation for infra teams that prefer provisioner as code
Adds aws_autoscaling_lifecycle_hook and lambda for graceful termination events when ASG is used
Provides module-level enable_gpu_driver_daemonset boolean to optionally install driver DaemonSet and node-check scripts
testing_plan: Create a dedicated private-e2e workspace with a small GPU quota (1-2 GPUs)
Deploy module with use_karpenter=false and validate ASG path: verify lifecycle hook triggers and drain flow during simulated AMI roll
Deploy module with use_karpenter=true and validate Karpenter path: ensure provisioner constraints (instanceTypes, zone, labels) are honored and scale-up respects taints/tolerations
Simulate GPU driver roll: flip driver image tag, run canary by cordoning one node and validate workloads successfully move and performance metrics match baseline
Run chaos/termination test: send Spot/instance termination signals and ensure graceful pod eviction and node replacement
Validate health check metrics exported and consumed by autoscaler rules documented
Record terraform plan/apply logs and attach to ticket as artifacts
